content.text: Digital creators in Zimbabwe face a significant barrier when it comes to setting up online stores: conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-every-detail-you-3|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are out of reach. This leaves creators stranded, unable to monetize their products effectively. The solution lies in a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers you with complete ownership over your sales process. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can finally establish a functional digital store that bypasses traditional payment hurdles. This guide will walk you through using Supabase as your order database, ensuring you can get your store live without relying on restricted platforms. You’ll learn every step necessary to build a robust infrastructure that supports your digital products, enabling you to achieve financial independence through your creations.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The reliance on conventional payment platforms can be detrimental in regions where they are unavailable or limited. By employing sovereign commerce infrastructure, you eliminate dependency on third-party services. This model provides you with complete control over your assets and operations. Supabase serves as a powerful order database, allowing you to store and manage your sales data effectively. The Edge Commerce Stack leverages open-source technologies to ensure your digital store runs smoothly and efficiently. With automatic [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-what-actually-how-4|Crypto Payments]] payment processing integrated into your infrastructure, you sidestep the complications of traditional banking systems. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-10|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] is designed to withstand the challenges of currency instability and payment rejection, giving you a reliable sales platform that is built for the realities of today’s digital economy.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your digital store using Supabase, there are some essential components you’ll need to gather. First, ensure that you have a clear understanding of your product offering, whether it be ebooks, courses, or digital assets. Next, you’ll want to set up a GitHub account for your website hosting and familiarize yourself with basic HTML and CSS for necessary customizations. You'll also need a domain name for your store, which establishes your brand presence online. Finally, you’ll require a crypto wallet to facilitate transactions through NOWPayments, which provides access to over 300 cryptocurrencies. Having these elements in place sets a solid foundation for deploying your Edge Commerce Stack and ensures that you can hit the ground running.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your foundational elements ready, focus on establishing your payment and delivery pipeline. Start by configuring your NOWPayments account, where you will link your crypto wallet. Ensure to set up automatic payment confirmations to trigger your product delivery once a transaction is complete. After this, leverage Supabase to create a database for your orders. This will involve defining tables for customers, products, and transactions, providing you with a structured way to manage sales data. With your backend in place, integrate your payment processing with your Supabase database to receive real-time updates on transactions. This seamless connection between your payment processor and database is crucial for keeping your operations smooth and efficient.
Supabase provides a robust, scalable solution for managing orders.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With the technical infrastructure set up, it’s time to go live. Start by deploying your GitHub Pages site, ensuring that your products are clearly displayed and accessible. Promote your store through social media channels to reach potential customers. When you're ready, run a test transaction to ensure that every component works as expected. This includes verifying that payments are processed correctly through NOWPayments and that product deliveries are automatically executed. Monitor your Supabase dashboard for any anomalies during the test. Once everything is functioning correctly, you can officially launch your store. This is an exciting moment, as you’ll be able to start receiving direct payments for your work without third-party restrictions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your store and processing your initial transactions, consider how you will scale your operations. Utilizing the capabilities of Supabase, you can expand your database to accommodate more products and increase transaction limits. Keep an eye on customer feedback to understand which products are performing well and which may need improvement. As your sales grow, think about automating certain processes, such as inventory management and customer communications, to streamline your operations. Additionally, explore cross-selling and upselling opportunities to maximize revenue. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed to grow with you, ensuring that you have a robust infrastructure capable of supporting your ambitions as a digital creator.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Supabase acts as an ideal order database for your digital store, especially in regions where traditional payment platforms are absent. By using Supabase in conjunction with the Edge Commerce Stack, you create a sovereign e-commerce environment that empowers you to manage orders efficiently while seamlessly processing payments. This architecture not only supports your immediate needs but also scales as your business grows.
NOWPayments gives you access to over 300 cryptocurrencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack, priced at $197, provides you with the essential tools to set up your online store quickly. It combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase to deliver a robust digital commerce solution, allowing you to focus on your products while we handle the infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Define your product offerings clearly. 2. Create a GitHub account and acquire a domain name. 3. Set up a crypto wallet and register with NOWPayments. 4. Install and configure Supabase to establish your order database. 5. Deploy your site using GitHub Pages. 6. Integrate NOWPayments with Supabase for order processing. 7. Test your infrastructure with a sample transaction. 8. Launch your store publicly and promote it on social media.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I really run a digital store without Stripe or PayPal?
Yes, with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can effectively manage a digital store using alternative crypto payment methods, bypassing the need for traditional payment platforms.
What kind of products can I sell using this setup?
You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, software, and templates. The infrastructure supports any digital asset you create.
How do I ensure payment confirmations are automatic?
By integrating NOWPayments with your Supabase setup, you can automate payment confirmations, triggering product deliveries without manual intervention.
Is there a limit to how many products I can sell?
There is no inherent limit to the number of products you can sell. As your store scales, Supabase can handle increased data and transactions effectively.
What should I do if I encounter issues during setup?
If you face challenges during setup, refer to the comprehensive documentation provided with the Edge Commerce Stack, or reach out for support within the 30-day support period included.
You maintain complete ownership and control over your digital store.
